summary: TOTAL SERVICE PARTNER AS (org. no. 981 393 899) is a private limited company (AS) based in Stavanger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1999-12-24. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 62.200 (Konsulentvirksomhet tilknyttet informasjonsteknologi og forvaltning og drift av it-systemer); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 6.8 m and net income was NOK 11 180. CEO: Terje Malmo; board chair: Bjarte Kvalheim; auditor: IREVISJON AS.
